name: Aquarius Reef Base

sources.title: Florida International University — Aquarius fact sheet (2019): 14 × 3 m, 82 t, baseplate 120 t, 18 m
Florida International University — Aquarius facilities and vessels (the baseplate holds it 13 ft off the bottom)
NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries — Meet Aquarius

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q623183_aquarius_reef_base.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/placekit.py) with AI assistance. On the sand beside Conch Reef off Key Largo, at about 18-19 m: the white habitat cylinder on its steel baseplate some 4 m above the bottom, the wet porch with its moon pool, the portholes of the living quarters, the equipment on top, the start of the umbilical, the small air-filled «gazebo» nearby, and the spurs of reef rock beside it. The heading and the layout round it are approximate; the life-support buoy at the surface is not drawn. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
